verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair thing to ask of an API gateway and SaaS platform, but the evidence pack never mentions any official client SDK library for Kong Gateway or Konnect. The closest items are a directory of OpenAPI specs, a RESTful Admin API, the decK and kongctl CLIs, and a Konnect MCP server. These are adjacent integration surfaces, not SDKs, so they are not credited here.
